blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Good business is polite business. "Please" and "thank you" are small words, but they have a big effect. When you write to a supplier, polite words open doors.

"Could you" is softer than "can you". It sounds kind, not like a command. "I appreciate" is formal and warm. You can end a business email with "best regards".

Today you learn five important words. We start slow. Say thank you, even in an email. Polite English is a business skill. You can do it!

items.q: According to the text, what do polite words do when you write to a supplier?
items.why: "polite words open doors" — palavras educadas abrem portas.

items.q: How is "could you" different from "can you"?
items.why: "'Could you' is softer than 'can you'."

items.q: Which phrase ends a business email?
items.why: "you can end a business email with 'best regards'."

items.q: The text suggests that the author would most likely DISAGREE with…
options: "Being polite is a waste of time."
"Say please and thank you at work."
items.why: Inferência: o texto todo defende que ser educado ajuda nos negócios, então discordaria dessa frase.

items.q: "We start slow" suggests that…
options: the lesson is easy to begin with
the lesson is only for experts
the email must be very long
items.why: Inferência: "we start slow" mostra que a lição começa fácil, passo a passo.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sara escrever um e-mail educado para um fornecedor. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi. My name is Sara. I work at the office. Today I write a short email to our supplier. I am new here, but I am not worried. I have a small trick, and my trick is to be polite.

First, I want to ask for the prices. But I do not say "send me the prices". That is a command. It is not polite, and I do not like it. So I write: "Could you please send me the prices?" This is soft and kind. "Could you" is better than "can you".

Then I say thank you. I write: "Thank you for your help. I appreciate it." These words are warm. The supplier feels good and reads my email with a smile.

At the end of the email, I do not just stop. I write "Best regards, Sara". This is a nice way to finish a business email.

Please and thank you are small words. But they are gold. Polite English opens doors. When I am kind, the supplier answers fast. So I always use please, could you, and thank you. It is easy, and it works. You can do it too!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Who does Sara write to today?
items.why: "Today I write a short email to our supplier."

items.q: Instead of "send me the prices", what does Sara write?
options: "Could you please send me the prices?"
items.why: "So I write: 'Could you please send me the prices?'"

items.q: How does Sara finish her email?
items.why: "I write 'Best regards, Sara'."

items.q: Why does Sara NOT say "send me the prices"?
options: It is a command and not polite
The supplier will not read it
It is in the wrong language
items.why: Inferência: ela diz que "send me the prices" é um comando e não é educado.

items.q: What does Sara think happens when she is polite?
items.why: Inferência: "When I am kind, the supplier answers fast" — ser educada traz uma resposta rápida.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Can you help me, please?" The word please is used to…
items.why: Please = por favor: torna o pedido educado.

items.q: Choose the correct words: "___ for your email. It helped me a lot."
items.why: Thank you = obrigado(a): agradece a ajuda.

items.q: Choose the correct words: "___ send me the report today?"
items.why: Could you = poderia você: pedido educado e suave.

items.q: "I appreciate your help." This means…
items.why: I appreciate = eu agradeço: formal e caloroso.

items.q: Choose the correct words to end an email: "See you soon. ___, Ana."
items.why: Best regards = atenciosamente: fecha um e-mail de negócios.

blocks.instruction: Expressões e verbos úteis em e-mails de negócios. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Could you get back to me tomorrow?" To get back to someone means to…
items.why: Get back to = dar retorno, responder depois.

items.q: "Please follow up with the supplier." To follow up means to…
items.why: Follow up = fazer o acompanhamento, checar de novo.

items.q: "Thank you for your help. Let me know if you have a question." Let me know means…
items.why: Let me know = me avise, me diga.

items.q: "Could you send over the prices, please?" To send over means to…
items.why: Send over = enviar (para mim/para cá).

items.q: "Best regards. Thanks again for your time." Thanks again means…
items.why: Thanks again = obrigado(a) mais uma vez, reforça o agradecimento.
